title: KalshiStakeVenueInstruction
description: The Kalshi order shape built from one mandate-admitted stake intent (ticker/action/side/count/type/priceCents/clientOrderId, the exact createOrder body @red-cup-engineering/kalshi-services-section's src/client.mjs already sends), plus the placement disposition (paper, unarmed, no-credential, or live) and the acknowledgement/reconciliation this instruction resolved to.

envelopeSnapshot.description: The envelope fields relevant to this instruction, captured at build time (never the live mutable file) so the receipt is self-contained.

mode.description: paper: --paper requested. unarmed: envelope.armed !== true. no-credential: KALSHI_API_KEY_ID/KALSHI_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH absent. live: the venue was actually called.

acknowledgementId.description: This instruction's acknowledgement record id, present only when mode is live.
